## PermissionCaseMismatchError class

Error thrown when a requested permission is well-formed but differs only in letter case from a permission the app defines. Matching is case-sensitive, so such a grant could never authorize the call it was meant for; rejecting it at creation names the permission to use instead of minting a dead key.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class PermissionCaseMismatchError extends Error
```

**Extends:** Error
